note: TAMA5 (cart type 0xFD): Gameboy_MiSTer keeps the TAMA5's 32 bytes in block RAM and writes 2 sectors, 1024 bytes: the 32 bytes at 0x000 and again at 0x100, 0x200 and 0x300, FF everywhere else. One file byte per TAMA5 byte, the layout of mGBA's and Gearboy's 32-byte .srm (7 of the 32 bytes differ from mGBA's: the pet's age and timers). No clock is saved (no RTC sector, no .rtc): like mGBA, unlike Gearboy's 72-byte .rtc. No seed: the core loads the (missing) save when the game loads and Main hands it FF blocks, hence the FF.
